about_the_game:
WELCOME ARACHNE!

Age: 33 years old

Zodiac Sign: Aries

Preferences: Gambling, cyber-gadgets.

Arachne is bold, straightforward, and fiercely independent. She lives by her own rules and is not an easy person to get close to. Secretive by nature, she loves playing cat and mouse with people. To her, life is a game, and losing doesn’t discourage her; it only fuels her thrill-seeking nature and hunger for the next challenge.

WHAT YOU'RE GETTING

From now on, Arachne will become not only your calming companion but also your passionate muse! She will always keep you company on the main screen with her graceful animations and captivating dialogues.

By purchasing this DLC, you get the Arachne mascot! You can switch your mascot at any time by opening your profile and choosing the "Mascot" tab.

Along with the mascot, you're getting 5000 credits and 150 super serum.

But most importantly, you're getting our undying gratitude! Thank you for considering purchasing this DLC!

content_descriptors.notes: All characters in the game are over 20 years old. This DLC contains explicit adult themes, including nudity and sexual acts. Please be aware and ensure that you are in an appropriate location before playing to avoid causing distress to others.
